name: Plugnition Restock Prediction & Alerts for WooCommerce
author: Plugnition

sections.description:
Plugnition Restock Prediction & Alerts for WooCommerce helps you predict which products are likely to run out of stock before it happens. Instead of reacting to stockouts after you’ve already lost sales, the plugin analyzes recent sales, estimates how long your current inventory will last, and highlights products that need attention.

The plugin integrates directly into WooCommerce, adding stock prediction data to your product list and providing a central dashboard for monitoring inventory health.

Key Features

  • Predict when products will run out of stock based on recent sales velocity.
  • Estimate the number of days of stock remaining.
  • Display clear stock risk statuses (Safe, Low Soon, Critical, Out of Stock).
  • View prediction data directly in the WooCommerce product list.
  • Display estimated average daily sales for each product.
  • Sort products by predicted days remaining or daily sales.
  • Dashboard overview of products that require attention.
  • Store supplier lead times for better restocking decisions.
  • Receive reorder timing recommendations based on supplier lead times.
  • Override calculated daily sales with custom values when needed.
  • Optional support for WooCommerce product variations.
  • Optionally subtract refunded quantities from sales calculations.
  • Cached calculations for improved performance on larger stores.
  • Fully integrated with WooCommerce.
  • Lightweight and easy to configure.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce stores that frequently run out of popular products.
  • Businesses managing supplier lead times.
  • Store owners who want simple inventory forecasting without complex ERP software.
  • Shops looking to reduce lost sales caused by unexpected stockouts.

Upgrade to Pro

The Pro version adds powerful automation features, including:

  • Automatic email alerts when products are predicted to run out of stock.
  • Duplicate alert prevention to avoid unnecessary notifications.

See the comparison between the Free and Pro versions on the plugin website.

How It Works

The plugin analyzes recent WooCommerce orders to calculate each product’s average daily sales. It compares this with the current stock quantity to estimate how many days remain before the product is expected to go out of stock. If supplier lead times are configured, the plugin also recommends when you should reorder to avoid running out of inventory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Start by visiting plugin settings at “WooCommerce > Settings > Restock Prediction & Alerts”.
